SPECIFICATION FOR

1. Scope — This Standard { Part 1 ) specifies the characteristics and dimensional requirements of 
high-power X-ray tubes with rotating anode. Type DRA-1, with two foci, each focus having the 
same target angle. 

2. Terminology ^ For the purpose of this standard, the terms and definitions given in IS ; 1885 
( Part 4/Sec 2)-1973 'Electrotechnical vocabulary : Part 4 Electron tubes. Section 2 X-ray tubes 
( first revision )' shall apply, 

3. Type Designation — The X-ray tubes shall be designated by three letters followed by a numeral, 
the first letter indicating the intended use of the tube, that is, diagnostic, therapeutic, etc, the second 
and the third letter indicating the type of anode, that is, either stationary anode or rotating anode. 
The numeral shall indicate the serial number of the particular type. 

Exampie 

DRA-1 shall mean diagnostic X-ray tube with rotating anode, type 1. 



4. Dimensions — The dimensions of the tube shall be within the limits specified in Fig. 1. 
outline, shape and design of the tube may not necessarily correspond to the figure.

4-1 The colour code for the terminals at the cathode end shall be as follows: 
Common : Black, Small focus : Red, Large focus : Blue.

Note — Heat Unit ( HU ) is the unit in which the anode heat capacity of the tube is usually expressed.

6. Protection — Housing shall be in accordance with IS : 6567-1972 'Radiation protection for an 
X-ray tube in a protective tube housing, operating between 10 kV and 400 kV. 

7. Information to be Furnished by tlie Manufacturer 

a) Tube Rating Characteristics 

1) Maximum current (mA) —time (s) characteristic, 

2) Filament characteristic for all types of operation, 

3) Emission characteristic, 

4) Cooling characteristic, 

5) Anode speed ( maximum ) and other relevant parameters. 

b) Recommended Details of Housing Suitable for the Tube 

The X-ray tube should have a mark on the glass surface through which the central ray 
exists. The mark could be of paint with negligible absorption to X-ray so that no shadow 
is cast even with the lowest kVp. 



18:10981 (Parti) -1988 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers the requirements of X-ray tubes to be used for the purpose of radiography 
and fluoroscopy in medical diagnostic X-ray apparatus of the static type. Various parts of this 
standard on diagnostic X-ray tubes with rotating anode cover the following types: 

Part 1 Type DRA-1 

Part 2 Type DRA-2 

Part 3 Type DRA-3 

Part 4 Type DRA-4 

Part 5 Type DRA-5 

Part 6 Type DRA-6 

The diagnostic X-ray tubes with stationary anodes are covered under 18:3154-1965 'Speci- 
fication for X-ray tubes, diagnostic type'.
